# emerging.tools — Full LLM Context

## Purpose
emerging.tools helps developers discover rising visual tooling, with a current focus on VS Code themes and a synced dataset of developer fonts.

## Primary User Intent
1. Find trending VS Code themes with lower install counts (emerging creators).
2. Compare themes quickly with previews, ratings, and update recency.
3. Discover trending developer fonts based on package/CDN momentum.

## Ranking Notes
- Themes are pulled from VS Code Marketplace and ranked with install velocity and quality signals.
- Fonts are pulled from Fontsource metadata and stats (`npmDownloadMonthly`, `jsDelivrHitsMonthly`), with optional Google Webfonts ranking signals when `GOOGLE_FONTS_API_KEY` is configured.

## Stable References
- Home: https://emerging.tools/
- Sitemap: https://emerging.tools/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://emerging.tools/robots.txt
- Theme detail pattern: https://emerging.tools/themes/{id}

## Structured Data
- Organization JSON-LD on layout
- WebSite JSON-LD on layout
- ItemList JSON-LD on home feed
- SoftwareApplication + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on theme detail pages

## Snapshots
- Theme latest snapshot file: `data/latest.json`
- Font latest snapshot file: `data/fonts-latest.json`
- Weekly snapshots: `data/weekly-YYYY-MM-DD.json` and `data/fonts-weekly-YYYY-MM-DD.json`

## Operational Endpoint
- `GET /api/sync` refreshes local snapshots outside Vercel
- Hosted Vercel mode dispatches GitHub workflow for snapshot refresh
